title: GateLab
description: Browser-based manual gating of flow and mass cytometry data. FCS files are parsed, transformed and gated locally; one population tree per workspace, tailored per file or per group; FlowJo workspace and FACSChorus import and export; Gating-ML 2.0; compensation; statistics and publication figures.
